target.description: Target(s) to scan: IP, hostname, subnet (CIDR), file path, or protocol://host:port (comma-separated for multiple)

delay.description: Delay between requests in milliseconds (to avoid rate-limiting)

log.description: Path to write log file (empty string disables logging)

useragent.description: User-Agent string to use in HTTP requests

proxy.description: HTTP(S) proxy URL (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:8080); empty string disables proxy

redishost.description: Redis server hostname or IP (for distributed scanning state); empty string disables Redis

protocols.description: List of protocols to test: http, ssh, ssh_key, ftp, snmp, smtp, telnet, rdp, mysql, postgres, etc.

output.description: Output filename (extension determines format: .csv, .html, .json); empty disables file output

shodan_key.description: Shodan API key (required for Shodan-based target discovery)

shodan_query.description: Shodan search query to fetch target list (requires shodan_key)

portoverride.description: If true, scan all listed protocols on all specified ports (instead of protocol-specific defaults)

ssl.description: Force SSL/TLS connections; fallback to plaintext on SSLError

resume.description: Resume from previous scan state (requires log + Redis or persistent state)

fresh.description: Discard previous scan state and start fresh

dryrun.description: Print URLs to be scanned without making requests

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint targets (e.g., version detection) without credential testing

validate.description: Validate credential files for correctness (no scanning performed)

dump.description: Print all loaded credentials to stdout (for inspection)

contributors.description: Display list of credential file contributors

name.description: Narrow testing to specific credential name(s), e.g., 'Apache Tomcat'

noversion.description: Skip service version detection (faster, less accurate)
